items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: the conductor was Stuff Smith conducting... I never will forget that first band that I heard... was something with A. G. Godley playing drums... Holloway, Trent and George Fielding* as the singers.

ctx.x: Stuff Smith was there at one time, but not as much. Jimmy Mundy was there. We had a very, very famous pianist named Emil Williams, I don't know if you ever heard of him, and...it's amazing that Benno Kennedy didn't ever come to Kansas City during those days, those two or three years I was there. Let's see. Who else was there that...we're leaving somebody out.
Well, there were so many musicians...
